jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Associate Product Manager, Enterprise AI
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
This is a great opportunity for an early-career product manager to develop their craft.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience.

Early career experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering or a related field (internships and graduate schemes considered).

Preferred:

Exposure to financial data, analytics systems or enterprise-scale data workflows.

Career Stage: Senior Associate
